name: meta
description: Meta skills for this marketplace: capture skill feedback from real runs as labeled GitHub issues.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain the marketplace's skills from real runs.
interface.longDescription: Meta skills for the marketplace itself. submit-skill-feedback captures the running session's feedback on how a marketplace skill performed during an actual run and files each item as a labeled GitHub issue in the marketplace repository.
defaultPrompt: Use $meta:submit-skill-feedback to file feedback on the marketplace skills this session ran.
